captions: Tuesday, 2:10 p.m. Town hall. Ticket A052.
The board says A047. You’ve been here since noon.
You don’t leave. You don’t complain. You wait.
In your notes, a du’a from August: “Guide my brother home.”
You said it three nights. Nothing changed. You stopped.
A052. Your turn came — because you stayed.
Asr. Last row. Your forehead on the carpet.
The same du’a. Night four. Then five. Then six.
This time, you don’t leave the line.

post.caption:
You waited 2 hours for a number. Allah got 3 days. 🤲

Ticket A052. The board says A047. You don’t leave, you don’t complain — you wait. But the du’a in your notes, “Guide my brother home,” you said three nights. Then you stopped.

“Indeed, Allah is with the patient.” (2:153)

This afternoon, in your next sujood: ask Him again. The same du’a.
